title_zh: 每週一段手機語音日記，AI 能估計憂鬱嚴重度到什麼程度？
title_en: Smartphone voice diaries for depression monitoring
summary_zh: npj Digital Medicine 的研究讓 284 名德語成人（128 名重鬱症、156 名健康對照）錄製每週語音日記，共 3,151 則，比較文字嵌入、聲學嵌入與傳統聲學特徵估計 BDI 分數。最佳多模態模型平均絕對誤差 4.37、R² 0.41，區分病人與對照 AUC 0.77；但追蹤同一人的變化接近隨機水準，且樣本只有德語使用者。
summary_en: In npj Digital Medicine, 284 German-speaking adults (128 MDD, 156 controls) recorded 3,151 weekly smartphone voice diaries. The best multimodal model estimated BDI scores with MAE 4.37 and R² 0.41, and separated patients from controls with AUC 0.77; tracking within-person change was near chance, and the cohort was German-speaking only.
evidence_note: 縱貫觀察研究與模型比較，無對照介入，無法推論臨床效益。

ethics_flags.note: 語音日記含大量個人內容，即使本地處理，作者仍指出隱私疑慮。
只用德語樣本，在其他語言或方言的效度未知。
refs: 偏誤與公平｜演算法偏誤

psych_concepts.name: 數位表型
psych_concepts.note: 以自然語音內容與聲學特徵推估憂鬱嚴重度。

caution: 對個人變化的追蹤接近隨機，且重度者易被低估，不適合用來監測個案病程。
brief_zh: 284 人、3,151 則每週 1–3 分鐘語音日記
文字模型（Qwen3-8B 等）表現優於純聲學特徵
個人內變化追蹤接近隨機；重度者易被低估
brief_en: Text embeddings (e.g., Qwen3-8B) beat pure acoustic features
Within-person tracking near chance; severe cases underestimated
supervision_questions: 模型能分辨病人與對照，卻抓不到同一人的變化，這對用於療程監測有什麼意涵？
若個案提供語音日記，治療者如何避免過度相信模型分數？

posts.author_name: Daniel Emden, Nils Opel et al.（npj Digital Medicine）
posts.title: Scalable depression monitoring with smartphone speech using a multimodal benchmark and topic analysis
posts.content: 德國團隊收集 284 名成人約 6 年、3,151 則每週手機語音日記，比較文字、聲學與多模態模型估計貝克憂鬱量表分數的表現。

related.title_zh: 系統性回顧：手機被動感測可提前 1–4 週預測精神疾病復發，但尚無研究證明改善結果
related.title_en: Digital phenotyping relapse prediction systematic review
related.summary_zh: BMC Psychiatry 的系統性回顧納入 52 篇、4,814 名參與者的研究，被動數位表型對 1–4 週後復發的預測 AUC 介於 0.70–0.88，多模態優於單一模態，個人化模型優於群體模型。睡眠改變、活動量與移動範圍下降、社交聯絡減少最具預測力；但 75% 研究偏誤風險高，多缺外部驗證，且沒有任何研究證明能改善臨床結果。
related.summary_en: A BMC Psychiatry systematic review of 52 studies (4,814 participants) found passive digital phenotyping predicted relapse 1–4 weeks ahead with AUCs of 0.70–0.88; multimodal and individual-level models performed better. Sleep changes, reduced activity and mobility, and less social communication were most predictive, but 75% of studies had high risk of bias, few had external validation, and none showed improved clinical outcomes.

related.title_zh: 英格蘭 15 個 NHS 地區限縮自閉症／ADHD 評估：英國自閉症協會強烈反對
related.title_en: NAS opposes NHS autism and ADHD assessment restrictions
related.summary_zh: 英格蘭 15 個 NHS 綜合照護委員會（涵蓋約 1,900 萬人）對自閉症與 ADHD 評估設下最少兩年的等候期，以控制成本。英國自閉症協會（NAS）政策主管 Mel Merritt 指出，診斷往往是取得支援與合理調整的前提，延誤會令兒童錯過關鍵學年並擴大不平等。
related.summary_en: Fifteen NHS Integrated Care Boards in England, covering about 19 million people, have imposed minimum two-year waits for autism and ADHD assessments. The National Autistic Society argues diagnosis is the gateway to support and that delays waste children's school years.

related.title_zh: 自閉症診斷是否過度擴張？英國自閉症協會回應 Uta Frith 新論文
related.title_en: NAS responds to Uta Frith on autism diagnosis
related.summary_zh: 認知心理學家 Uta Frith 在《Psychological Medicine》發表〈自閉症譜系障礙：是否已失去意義並導致誤診？〉，質疑現行診斷範圍過寬。英國自閉症協會回應，診斷增加反映社會認識提升，所提亞型仍屬理論、缺乏臨床應用價值，並提醒不要讓自閉症人士互相對立。
related.summary_en: Uta Frith's paper in Psychological Medicine questions whether the autism spectrum diagnosis has lost meaning and drives misdiagnosis. The NAS responds that rising diagnoses reflect awareness, that proposed subtypes remain theoretical, and warns against pitting autistic people against each other.
